info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Visits Summary API
info.description: VisitsSummary API lets you access the core web analytics metrics (visits, unique visitors, count of actions (page views & downloads & clicks on outlinks), time on site, bounces and converted visits.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
Specific metrics to include, or `false` to return the default set.

request.description: Returns the VisitsSummary overview report for the requested period.

response.name:
VisitsSummary metrics for the requested period.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

(Required) Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

request.description: Returns the total visit duration formatted as human-readable text.

response.name:
Numeric archive result containing Human-readable visit duration values.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
